yearsToFirstCrop.notes: No qualified numeric planting-to-first-food age in the checked sources. Record planting date, starting age and actual bearing.

yearsToFullBearing.notes: No measured full-bearing age was established; no yield ramp is inferred.

yieldKgPerTreeMature.notes: No qualified food kg per plant with age, edible-product basis and management context. Missing output is unknown.

chillUnits.notes: No cultivar-specific numeric chilling requirement verified.

evidence.quote: It is necessary to plant both female and male plants

pollination.notes: Only female plants bear fruit; source provides no stocking ratio or age-specific output.

supplementaryReferences.title: Edible part and local use
supplementaryReferences.quote: Only female plants bear the colourful fruit.
supplementaryReferences.note: SANBI describes sweet, jelly-like ripe flesh. January–May is fruiting; it does not state exact ripe-picking limits.

care: Use well-drained soil and sun. The source excludes the Cape winter-rainfall area from its natural distribution and distinguishes several subspecies.
purchase: Ask the nursery to identify the subspecies and sex and provide compatible male and female plants for fruit.

sourceChecks.observations: Read indexed primary SANBI page content. Direct PlantZAfrica requests in this audit returned HTTP 403; this is not a claim that every individual endpoint was live-tested.

gaps: No explicit ripe-picking interval or mature kg.
